Instructions for Use
Device description: The Umbra Pacemaker System is a cardiac pacing system. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
MR Conditional (≤ 3 T): spatial field gradient ≤ 7.2 T/m (720 gauss/cm); Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.5 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode; Scan for up to 30 minutes.
Device configuration during MRI: MRI mode ON.
Image artifact: up to 7 mm.
